scope: Corollary 7.13 of the manuscript “Midpoint convexity from bounded tree potentials and path costs” (preprints/Midpoint-convexity-from-bounded-tree-potentials-and-path-costs-September-27-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 331 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 965c8f078bcaef03), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 39. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every ρ > 0, choose 0 < γ < 1/2 such that 9 q (1 + γ)2 − (1 − 2γ)2 < ρ/3. If ∥x∥q ≥ 1 − γ, its symmetric lens {y : ∥x ± y∥q ≤ 1} has no infinite ρ-separated subset.
